contexts.name: phone-normal
contexts.lore: Kilnkeeper tends the warm river kilns where rootwood beams are steamed and copper vessels are shaped, keeping each emberseed dry between shifts. When raiders threaten the workshop, he loads one emberseed into his broad-mouthed launcher and sends a single burst of sparks skittering across the ground.
